description: Makes an avatar from the user's own photo with a genframe preset and scene (see list_presets). Charged like one picture. Use only a photo of the user themself or of someone who agreed.

caption.description: Text on the poster for scenes with a caption; empty string = no text.

photo_job_id.description: Or one of the user's genframe pictures.

photo_url.description: The person's photo: public https URL or a link from this server.

style.description: Scene id from list_presets (default: the first).
